status: PENDING USER APPROVAL — DO NOT DEPLOY THESE CARDS YET. The live cards at public/cards/*.json are unchanged and still match the on-chain hashes. Deploying the new cards before the on-chain update would break 'Verify card hash'.
stepsAfterApproval: 1. Copy buyer-agent-card.json and seller-agent-card.json from this directory over public/cards/buyer-agent-card.json and public/cards/seller-agent-card.json.
2. Run the two submit-call.mjs commands below (each signs with the agent's derived testnet key and submits via the wallet-proxy; ~5 CCD fee each, sponsored by the agent account itself).
3. Deploy to Vercel, then verify both cards with GET /v1/verify-agent-card/{badge}?network=testnet (must show fetched sha256 == on-chain hash).
4. Push the updated cards to GitHub and update the sync record.
